CONNECTED THROUGH YOUR HUB

AI connection

Contracts uses your organisation’s provider and model. You do not need a separate API key here.

Test the model

Send one short, neutral example through the same connection used for document analysis. No contract text or personal data is sent. Each test uses one request from the daily AI budget.

Where to change things

A Hub owner manages the provider, model and API key in Hub Settings → AI and enables the AI lane under Apps → Contracts → Lanes. After a change, refresh the connection here. Contracts administrators can run the model test and adjust the daily budget under Settings.

If a document failed earlier, open its Inbox details → Filing → Read again with AI. Your original stays attached. AI reads original PDF pages and images, including scans. Check its readings against the original; a connection test alone does not validate a particular document.

Connect the email relay

Start here: Google Workspace setup, shared intake and recovery →

Mail reaches this app through a small relay that receives the contracts address, splits the message into text and files and hands it in here. Only the identities listed below may hand in mail. Add the relay's identity before you deploy it; remove it to rotate. The relay ships with this app under contracts/relay/ — the setup guide walks through the address, forwarding and identity.

Without a relay

Upload saved .eml files in the inbox (Gmail: ⋮ → Download message; Outlook: drag the message to the desktop). Same pipeline, same proposals — just by hand.

Hub connection

Roles and access are managed in the Hub. Global Hub owners and admins have Admin access; other roles are assigned per app. View Hub permissions ↗

Deadlines and reminders

The internal decision date is set this many days before the last cancellation date. Reminders go out these many days before each date, through the hub (bell, and Slack if the person switched it on) — title and link only, never amounts.

Sample data

Six fictional contracts, one message in the inbox and a proposal to try the flow. Removable in one click.

Import from a spreadsheet

Export your sheet as CSV, paste it here (or pick the file), then say which column means what. You get a preview of every row before anything is written. Rows that match an existing contract (vendor + product + reference) are skipped, never overwritten. Amounts may be written the way your sheet writes them (1,500.00 · 1.500,00 · 1'500.50).

Take your data with you

CSV contains confirmed records visible to you in the selected workspace. Workspace JSON also includes the sources, proposals, document metadata, tasks and history you can access. It identifies the workspace but is not a complete instance backup or an automatic restore file. Download document files separately.

WhenWhoWhat
← Guide

Bring your contracts inbox.

Forward an email or keep the address in CC. Review the document in the same place as an upload.

Google Workspacecontracts@your-company→Email relayCloudflare Worker→Contract intakeReview → choose a space

Recommended: one shared, restricted intake space.

Choose the built-in Contract intake workspace. Hub-assigned app admins can review and distribute its documents. Admins assigned to Contracts in Hub also have access. Connect the incoming mailbox to this space. Anyone can submit an email, but submitting does not grant access to the inbox. Personal uploads can go straight to your personal space.

During review, choose a destination you own. The email, attachments and suggestions move together. Moving an existing contract is available under its Access tab. App admins can also route into another person’s personal space.

1. Create the Google Workspace address

Use a private Google Group such as contracts@your-company, with conversation history enabled so a copy stays in Google. Restrict who can view conversations and members. Allow external posting if vendors will keep the address in CC; that does not require a public archive. Add the relay address as an external member with “Each email” delivery. Your Workspace administrator must allow external members.

A dedicated Gmail mailbox with an administrator-managed forwarding copy also works if you prefer mailbox retention and recovery. Avoid a forwarding-only alias with no retained copy.

Google’s group settings guide ↗
2. Receive on a separate Cloudflare subdomain

For example, use contracts@relay.kebabstack.com for the forwarding destination. Enable Email Routing for that subdomain and route the exact address to the Contracts Email Worker. Keep the company domain’s existing Google MX records.

Cloudflare’s subdomain setup ↗
3. Trust the relay, then bind the intake space

The operator generates a dedicated relay key and deploys the Worker using the downloadable runbook. Store its secret only in Cloudflare. In Workspace tools → Mail setup, save the public address and the relay’s public principal.

Open Contract intake → Access & mail setup. Connect the same principal. Both steps are required: infrastructure trust alone grants no access to a workspace. The sender, subject and email headers never choose the destination.

4. Keep a recovery copy

Configure a separate, verified fallback mailbox that a reviewer monitors. Do not point it back to contracts@ or the relay address. If parsing, attachment limits or storage fail, the complete original is forwarded there. If recovery also fails, the Worker rejects the delivery. This is not a guaranteed automatic retry queue; retain and check the Google copy.

5. Test one complete round trip

Send a harmless text PDF to the public address. Check that it appears in Contract intake, open its original, correct one extracted field and save to a destination. Forward the same email again: it should be recognised as a duplicate. Send a reply in the same thread and check its proposal. Finally, temporarily use an untrusted test relay identity to verify recovery delivery before relying on the mailbox.

What can AI tell me about negotiation and signatures?

AI reads the email and original pages, including scanned signature areas. It distinguishes signature requests, visible marks and reported completion, and flags uncertainty. A signature mark, typed name or filename is not verification of identity, a digital signature or legal finality.

Context includes the current email, its attachments, quoted text and up to four previously received messages referenced by its mail headers in the same workspace. It cannot read unseen emails or your personal mailbox. Once a contract moves, later mail still enters the shared intake space; choose a destination and use Move document there for review. Matching runs again inside that space without creating a duplicate contract; Add to an existing contract lets you choose the record manually. Both spaces must be owned by the reviewer. No automatic cross-space search exposes private contracts.

THE CONTRACTS GUIDE

From a document to a decision.

Upload a SaaS contract, confirm the essentials, and stay ahead of its next renewal.

01 · COLLECT

Add the original.

Add a document, saved email or pasted text to Inbox. Everything goes into the workspace shown above.

Open inbox → 02 · REVIEW

Keep a person in control.

AI suggests details with source evidence. Check the fields, correct anything uncertain and save the changes you approve.

Review incoming items → 03 · MANAGE

Make the record useful.

Choose an owner and save the reviewed subscription. Uncheck active tracking for an offer or draft. Dates, costs and license holders appear in your SaaS table.

Open contracts →

No AI suggestion? You can still file it.

Choose Add contract and upload the original. The review page lets you complete missing details and save the contract with its document in one step. In the inbox, use Review & file for unfiled items; use Suggestions for updates to an existing contract. Rejecting a proposal preserves the original document; it does not accept or cancel an agreement.

Who can see this workspace?

Personal: its owner and app admins. Teamspace: explicit members — owners manage access, editors maintain records and viewers read and export. Restricted records are limited to their named people and space owners, all within that space. Active Hub owners/admins and Hub-assigned Contracts Admins have access to all content and settings. Archived spaces remain readable but cannot be changed.

Keep a second owner on a teamspace. These are application access controls; hosting controllers and your configured AI provider are outside that boundary.

What does AI read?

With the Hub AI lane enabled, original PDFs and supported images go to your organisation’s configured AI provider for visual reading, alongside message context. This includes scanned pages, receipts and purchase screenshots. Text quotes are checked against extracted text; visual quotes are marked as AI readings for you to verify. Suggestions cannot sign, pay, renew or cancel anything.

When will Slack remind us?

Settings → Renewal reminders starts at 90 days before renewal or expiry, with 60/30/7-day follow-ups by default. Earlier cancellation deadlines are also checked 90 days ahead. Choose the owner, workspace owners, Hub admins/owners and optional groups. Recipients must already have contract access. The Hub notify lane, app URL, Slack bot and recipient DM preferences must be configured. Checks run every six hours after a fresh directory update.

What do the cost totals mean?

Annual run rate annualizes recorded active subscriptions. Historical accrual estimates costs across known dates and saved price changes, capped at today. Recorded invoices/receipts are separate and do not prove payment. Currencies and tax bases stay separate; missing values are disclosed. Open Management report, pick a year, then download CSV or print/save PDF.

Can AI look up missing renewal terms?

When terms are absent, AI can identify an official vendor page and read its public text. You can enter a direct URL. Source and retrieval time stay visible, and nothing is applied until you choose Use as a reviewed suggestion. Current public terms may differ from your agreement; blocked or unreadable pages leave values unknown.

What about software keys and group assignments?

License keys have a separate inventory with hidden values and audited reveal. Values are not sent to AI or included in ordinary exports. People and groups come from Hub. Group assignments keep the roster current without granting access to contracts or provisioning vendor accounts. Other employees cannot access unshared personal content; app admins can.

How do emails reach a team?

Open the mail setup guide for the Google Workspace and Cloudflare steps. A space owner connects a separately trusted relay identity to a dedicated incoming address. CC that address or forward a thread there. This requires a configured relay; an address alone does not receive messages. Deduplication and matching remain inside the workspace. Matching routine invoices can be filed automatically; material changes need review.

Can I delete documents or records?

Use Delete item on an inbox document or Delete record on a saved record. It moves to Trash in the same workspace and can be restored. Deleting a record also hides its linked originals and stops its reminders. No file is permanently erased. Workspace permissions still apply.

What if a colleague changes the same contract?

Saves check the record’s revision. If someone changed it while you were reviewing, reload and compare before saving. Decisions, source evidence and record history stay available.

How do I import or export records?

Settings → Import & export accepts mapped CSV rows with a preview before writing. Existing records are not overwritten. CSV export protects against spreadsheet formulas. Workspace JSON includes visible records and metadata; download document files separately. Older records may be in Existing contracts, with their previous access preserved.

What limits should I know?

Files: up to 1.5 MB each, 10 per message. Keep originals below 1.4 MB for AI reading; larger files may need compression because encoded requests have a separate limit. PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF use the Hub vision model, or its main model if no separate one is set. That model must support the file type. Original PDFs are sent complete; supplementary text is bounded. Encrypted, damaged or unreadable documents can still require a clearer copy. Review small print, dates and signature pages. An app admin configures the daily AI budget. Reminders use a fixed UTC offset; daylight-saving changes are not automatic.
